outcome: Lobulated soft tissue lesion in posterior bladder wall
Firm mass adhered to bladder and uterus
cohort: This study describes two women, aged 29 and 33, who presented with various symptoms and were ultimately diagnosed with bladder endometriosis.
finding: A comprehensive diagnostic approach utilizing imaging techniques alongside histopathology and immunohistochemistry is essential for the accurate diagnosis of bladder endometriosis and its differentiation from other gynecological conditions or malignancies.
mod_finding: One case had a history of two uneventful cesarean sections.
